item.title: Dutch to Ask EU to End Mandatory Gas Storage Targets
item.description: The Netherlands wants to scrap mandatory gas storage targets under a revamp of the European Union's energy supply security rules after spending nearly EUR 1 billion this year to fill the country's reserves.

item.title: Vietnam’s BSR inks crude oil supply agreement with ExxonMobil
item.description: Petrovietnam Refining and Petrochemical Corporation (BSR) has entered into a framework agreement to purchase crude oil from ExxonMobil Asia Pacific, an affiliate of ExxonMobil.

item.title: Eni wins Sapukala exploration block in Indonesia’s Kutei Basin
item.description: Italian energy company Eni has secured a new deepwater exploration licence in Indonesia's Kutei Basin after being awarded the Sapukala block with a 100% participating interest.

item.title: Select to acquire Delaware Basin-focused Pilot Water for $700m
